name: grape-kit
description: Remote control for Grape DevOps pipelines: trigger and track multi-agent workflows (vod→issue→coding→qa→sre), manage issues end-to-end, and take over running cloud tasks into the local session. MCP wiring: after install, run `atomcode mcp add --global grape-kit npx -- -y -p @grape-dev/grape-kit grape-kit-mcp` to register the 50-tool MCP server.
